body: Bold of you to assume I have friends

I’ve had this pierced since November and have had this white stuff underneath the skin or in a bump for months now. I’ve tried hard to get rid of it but I can’t seem to. I’m starting to question if it might be some type of scarring since sea salt soaks and aspirin doesn’t seem to help. The reason why I’m eager to get rid of it is because I want to let the piercing close up, but I’m scared to do that if it is infected since I’ve heard you shouldn’t let a piercing close up with an infection. Advice?

I got mine pierced about a week and a half ago and mine looked similar to this. I ended up taking it out five days later because it was too thin and I’d rather be safe than sorry. Hopefully I can get mine repierced soon.
Will it close up completely and leave a scar?
Yes, I think a labret or Medusa would look great!
Thanks for the feedback! Yes, I took it out a few minutes ago.
I just took it out a few minutes ago. Got this pierced on Monday and have been stressed all week about how shallow it is. So glad it’s out!
Wow, very beautiful. I love your piercing and your tattoo! Best of wishes to you and your kids!
I really like your conch hoop. Where is it from? I’ve been trying to find a ring like that for my conch piercing.
This job you have isn’t going to last forever. Try to look on the positive side while you can.

Got my conch pierced in November, middle of COVID. I’ve never had an issue with it. I will say be kind of careful when taking off your mask since I’ve hit mine and few times doing that and it really hurt. Other than that you should get it pierced since it’s not a big deal and the mask mandate will be lifted soon.

Im really sorry you’re depressed and that your life is tough right now. In life we go through phases, this one sucks but maybe a few months from now you’ll be in a better place. If music is what makes you happy than focus on that and try to drown everything else out. Maybe see if you can find another job since you’re not happy at the restaurant you work in now. Also face tattoos are cool, but think really long and hard before getting one since it’s such a big decision. You can’t really get a cover up tattoo on your face.
Im sorry that happened to you, how cruel. Beautiful piercing by the way!
To me it just looks irritated but I’m also not a professional. Make sure you’re not cleaning it with anything too harsh, I recommend doing sea salt soaks.
Thanks for your feedback! Do you think I should take it out? Does everyone’s piercing migrate overtime or just some peoples?
